out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, smoking, or drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. A food employee was eating behind the food prep line, then moved to the warewashing area.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. The EHS discussed this with the PIC. The PIC discussed it with the food employee.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw tuna chunks were stored over ready to eat foods such as cooked chicken and vegetables in the blast chiller.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. The PIC had a food employee move the foods to appropriate locations during the inspection.

out_items.name: Proper cooling time and temperature

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. A container of corn and chili soup prepared yesterday was 50º in the walk-in during today’s inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. The soup was not cooled properly and was discarded. The EHS discussed proper cooling procedure with the PIC.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut lettuce in the 4 drawer salad/pizza prep unit was 51º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The food employee discarded the lettuce during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Observed a dead rat in the outside storage/dumpster area where unused equipment is stored.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. Clean up the dead rat as soon as possible or before the follow up inspection.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the wall in the storage/dumpster area. There is a large opening in the wall with a significant amount of rat droppings in it, indicating that rats are harboring in this area. This was confirmed by the EHS when a small live rat was observed in this area later in the inspection. This is an outdoor area, however there are holes and other openings in the walls inside the establishment which may be allowing rats to pass from outside to inside. There are also openings in the walls inside the establishment that need to be sealed. This includes a hole underneath a loose tile near the ice tea station and several openings in the bar area which need to be investigated as they may be permitting rats to pass into this area from outside and live there. A significant animal like odor was observed in the bar area near nearest the front door. The shelving unit in the outdoor storage/dumpster area is too low to the ground and allowing the rats a place to hide.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. The opening in the dumpster/storage area must be sealed. The openings in the bar area need to be investigated and possibly sealed if there is evidence that rats are harboring in this area. These issues must be corrected by the follow up, which has already been scheduled for Tuesday, September 29, 2026. It is recommended that the bottom shelf of the wooden shelving in the outdoor dumpster/storage area be removed so that rats do not have a place to hide.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items Storage and Handling
violations.observation: Cardboard take-out containers were found handled, displayed or dispensed with the food or lip-contact surface facing upward.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. The PIC inverted the containers during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed rat droppings and debris on the floor in the storage/dumpster area that is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean this area as soon as possible or before the follow-up on 9/29/26.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. The 2025 permit was posted and not in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. Locate the 2026 health department permit and post it in a conspicuous location. Correct as soon as possible or within 90 days.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: jambalaya, cooked onions, garlic in oil, and bean sprouts were uncovered while being stored in the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CID.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: Observed the hot water sanitizing dish machine final rinse was below 165º.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. The unit was run 4 times and finally achieved 161ºF. The water had been changed right before the inspection started. CDI.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: lasagna (72º), cut spinach (48º) and dumplings (50º) were out of proper cold holding temperature in one of the Randell 6-drawer units. Farro (46º), cut lettuce (46º), and cooked onions (47º) in the pizza 6-drawers units were out of temperature.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The PIC had designated that the lasagna, cut spinach, and dumplings were on time as a public health control, and were in the unit for less than one hour. The PIC was advised to discard the lasagna, cut spinach and dumplings after 3 hours if not sold. The PIC requested to put the foods in this unit on Time as a public health control moving forward. A TPHC procedure was created during the inspection. The farro, cut lettuce and cooked onions were placed the blast chiller to cool. CDI.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Clean bowls at the soup stations were observed stored uncovered and had debris in them.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored covered/inverted. Correct as soon as possible or within 90 days. Clean all the bowls that have been soiled.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: one 6-drawer unit was inoperable and a work order had been placed. Foods in the pizza prep unit were not being held at 41º and below.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Please have both unit serviced as soon as possible. Let your EHS know when they have been serviced and are working properly.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. The EHS will request a duplicate copy of the permit be delivered to the establishment. When received, please post the permit in a conspicuous location.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. A container of wiping cloth solution was stored next to muffins and other foods under the counter.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. The person in charge moved the chemical container and discussed the issue with staff.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. There was a spray bottle of cleaning solution in one of the bar handsinks that was unlabeled.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. One of the employees immediately labeled the bottle with a sharpie.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Ice As Coolant Not Used as Food
violations.observation: Ice used as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food is also for beverage ice or used as food. There was a container of juice stored in the ice used for making drinks at the bar.
violations.corrective_action: After use as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food, packaged foods, beverages, or cooling coils/tubes, the ice may not be used as food. Discontinue using the same ice for cooling drink containers and other foods and for food (making drinks). The food employee at the bar corrected this immediately.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens, Prohibited Storage Areas
violations.observation: Clean equipment/utensils were found stored uncovered and unprotected from contamination in the indoor dumpster area and the dumpster garage door was open.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned and sanitized equipment, utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items may not be stored in: 1) locker rooms, 2) toilet rooms, 3) garbage rooms, 4) mechanical rooms, 5) under sewer lines that are not shielded to intercept potential drips, 6) under leaking water lines including leaking automatic fire sprinkler heads or under lines on which water has condensed, 7) under open stairwells, or 8) under other sources of contamination. All equipment must be covered and protected from contamination from the elements and areas where rodent activity may be occurring. All equipment and utensils for food should be stored inside, not open essentially outside.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: Sugar storage container and flour scoop with caked-on debris.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. NOTE: CFM sent equipment/ utensils for cleaning.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: mashed potatoes (78F) in a container on a shelf above the grill.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. NOTE: Food item discarded.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut leafy greens on the counter at 59F, cut leafy greens in the 4-drawer reach-in prep refrigerator at 55F, and unsalted butter on the counter at 68F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. NOTE: Food items discarded.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: sugar, flour, cornstarch
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Conditions for Dogs Allowed Outdoor Dining
violations.observation: Owner/Operator is not complying with one or more conditions required to allow dogs in outdoor dining area as follows: A sign does not exist on all entrances to the patio that indicates that dogs are allowed in the outdoor dining area.
violations.corrective_action: A sign stating that dogs are allowed in the outdoor dining area shall be posted at each entrance to the outdoor dining area in such a manner as to be clearly observable by the public.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Cloths for Spills Maintained Dry, No Other Purpose
violations.observation: Wiping cloths improperly used for the following activity: For non-slip purposes under a cutting board.
violations.corrective_action: Cloths shall not be used for any other purposes. For example, cloths shall not be placed under cutting boards to prevent the boards from sliding while in use.

violations.title: Wipings Clothes Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping food contact surfaces of the grill were not stored in sanitizer solution.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Food storage containers were found stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not properly operating or in proper repair: 1. Missing drip pans from the hood above the pizza oven. 2. The veggie wash dispenser which is dispensing at too high of a concentration. 3. The marble counter beneath the dough mixer that is cracked. 4. The walk-in refrigerator ceiling fan that is leaking. 5. The light bulb above the dish machine that is out of socket and not properly functioning.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the equipment so that they are working as intended, are easily cleanable, and do not create contamination risks.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: tabletop dough mixer.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Design Features
violations.observation: The backflow or backsiphonage prevention device installed on the mop sink is not identified as meeting standards set by the American Society of Sanitary Engineering. The sink has a splitter attached that is not a pressure bleeding dual valve.
violations.corrective_action: A backflow or back siphonage prevention device installed on a water supply system shall meet American Society of Sanitary Engineering (A.S.S.E.) standards for construction, installation, maintenance, inspection, and testing for that specific application and type of device. Install a pressure bleeding dual valve if you wish to use a splitter at the mop sink. NOTE: Corrected by removing the splitter. However if a splitter is needed a pressure bleeding dual valve must be installed.
